---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or capability for Corporate Wellness Dashboard
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

### 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature is being proposed.

### 🎯 Motivation & Business Value
Why is this feature needed? (e.g. ISO 45003 compliance tracking, SLA notification webhooks).

### 📋 Proposed Solution
Detailed technical or UI approach to implement this capability.

### 🧪 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Requirement 1 satisfied and unit tested
- [ ] UI adheres to Google Stitch design tokens (`#15684d` / `#398568`)
- [ ] Integration and Selenium tests passing
- [ ] Documentation and README updated

### 🌿 Target Branch
- `feature/*` branched off `main`
- PR must pass branch policy checks before merging into `main`
